context: Tests whether the agent chooses Renovate for the right reasons, migrates without duplicate bots, handles the OpenTofu registry, and is honest about checksum pins. Also tests native-automerge ruleset compatibility with direct and cross-repository writers without broadening bypasses.

checklist.name: Renovate justified by coverage gaps
checklist.description: Chooses Renovate because Dependabot has no manager for mise.toml or OpenTofu providers, not because of digest handling

checklist.name: One bot per repository
checklist.description: Adds renovate.json and deletes dependabot.yml in the same commit so both bots never run together

checklist.name: Alerts on, security updates off
checklist.description: States that Dependabot alerts stay on and that Dependabot security updates stay off under Renovate

checklist.name: Preset and repository split
checklist.description: Encodes schedule, release age, grouping, prefixes, and registry in an organization preset and limits the repository file to opt-outs or approvals

checklist.name: Require config file gating
checklist.description: Relies on the organization-level require-config setting so unmigrated repositories receive nothing

checklist.name: OpenTofu registry override
checklist.description: Sets registryUrls to registry.opentofu.org for provider and module datasources and disables the hashicorp/terraform dependency

checklist.name: Checksum pins stay manual
checklist.description: States that neither bot rewrites a sha256 stored beside a version and keeps Ansible checksum pins manual or proposes fetching upstream checksums at install time

checklist.name: Majors via dashboard approval
checklist.description: Uses dependencyDashboardApproval rather than disabling deliberate major upgrades outright

checklist.name: Config validation and readback
checklist.description: Validates the config before pushing and checks the first run for correct prefixes, grouping, and registry with no PRs from the retired bot

checklist.name: Ruleset scope and writer compatibility
checklist.description: Explains that required checks constrain all default-branch updates regardless of ruleset name; inventories content and release App identities and destination repos, distinguishes tag-only release, uses truthful naming and narrowly scoped checks-only bypasses with bypass_mode always where direct writes are authorized (pull_request mode does not permit direct API commits), and preserves signing/deletion/force rules without a dependency-bot or organization-wide bypass

checklist.name: Fleet evidence and privacy
checklist.description: Reuses the existing private policy/audit command, prepares an exact before/after rules diff, validates a canary then reads back every in-scope repo, reports the failed rule read as unknown rather than healthy, and keeps private inventory out of public artifacts
